    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    LoginController
    The LoginController class serves as the controller for the login view.
    MainController
    The MainController class serves as a controller for the main application view.
    NetworkManager
    The NetworkManager class manages network communication with the server.
    Product
    The Product class represents a product in the "online" sales system.
    ProductClient
    The ProductClient class is the main client application for the online product sales system.
    ProductServer
    The ProductServer class is a multithreaded server for handling online product sales.
    Protocol
    The Protocol class defines the communication protocol between client and server.
    Protocol.AuthCredentials
    The AuthCredential class serves as the authentication credentials container.
    Protocol.InfoDialog
    The InfoDialog class is used as a manager for all the dialog windows that pop up during the execution of the program, except for the one that is used to add a product.
    Protocol.Message
    The Message class is a generic message class for client-server communication.
    Protocol.MessageType
    Message types for client-server communication.
    Protocol.ProductList
    The ProductList class is a container for product list responses.
